newsitem.title: SPAIN: Tabacalera ups Zabalburu stake to 21.18 pct.
newsitem.headline: Tabacalera ups Zabalburu stake to 21.18 pct.

text.p: Spanish tobacco group Tabacalera said its Hebra, Promocion e Inversiones S.A. Sociedad Unipersonal subsidiary had bought 452,726 shares, or 18.25 percent, of real estate group Inmobiliaria Zabalburu.

In a mandatory disclosure to the stock market commission CNMV on Wednesday, Tabacalera said this raised Hebra's total stake in the group to 21.18 percent, given the prior purchase of 72,842 shares, or 2.93 percent, of the group.
Tabacalera said this purchase was made at 2,440 percent share for a total of 1.1 billion pesetas.
